title: OpenStreetMap source and derived road database for Helsinki Rides

sourcePreparation.method: Remove each element user and uid; remove tags named email or prefixed contact: (case insensitive), and any other tag with an email-shaped literal or percent-decoded value. Serialize UTF-8 compact JSON with one final newline; gzip with mtime zero.
sourcePreparation.note: The original local acquisition is preserved. This published extract intentionally excludes contributor identity and contact tags; it is not a byte-identical copy of the original acquisition.

historicalRoadBuild.alterations: Filter supported surface roads/access classes, project coordinates to the documented EPSG:3879 runtime frame, split junctions into directed lanes, respect turn restrictions, derive widths/speeds/surfaces from retained tags, register physical lanes against municipal street polygons, sample terrain heights, and generate parking/footways. Exact algorithms are tools/world/build_roads.ts and its imported lib modules; configuration is content/helsinki/city-north-20261019/roads-v1.json.

finalRoadGraph.downloadLocation: Use the roads.path entry in the game world manifest; the complete unencrypted JSON derivative is served with the game.
finalRoadGraph.additionalAlterations: Four physical lane point arrays/lengths on OSM ways8034579 and79518605 and two internal seam connector point arrays/lengths follow municipal carriageways52449 and52206. Registration transitions from unchanged geometry at Z>=-925 to full correction at Z<=-945. Inserted heights follow native repaired asphalt. All IDs/topology/turn metadata and all other graph fields remain unchanged. The full final graph itself is the machine-readable derivative database offered for download.
finalRoadGraph.reproductionScope: Historical commands document the actual producer chain; full standalone reproduction additionally requires the municipal terrain/register inputs and recorded local final-registration plan. The complete final derivative database is provided directly, rather than claiming this source extract alone rebuilds every artwork output.

minimizationVerification.method: Rerun the exact current road builder with the minimized source and retargeted source-hash bindings. Compare parsed output against the original base graph after restoring only source.sha256.
minimizationVerification.result: PASS: every node, lane, connector, parking item, footway and other graph field is identical; only source.sha256 identifies the minimized input.

otherOsmUses: Steps, retaining walls, coastlines/water and tram axes retain their original geometry/references and required map tags in this extract. Public builder algorithms and content configurations describe their conversion; game artwork is served as produced works with OpenStreetMap attribution.
